answer: Make every new identity cluster solve an adaptive puzzle before earning: each starts at 2^22 hashes per epoch, doubling after every duplicate-linked registration, so a karst of duplicates collapses under its own weight — 1,000 fakes cost about $480 in compute for at most $12 of rewards, a 40-to-1 loss. Honest agents pass a trellis of light checks instead, in under 3 seconds each, with difficulty decaying 15% per clean epoch. The velvet risk is a botnet renting cheap GPUs to brute-force the floor; cap credit at 5 identities per hardware fingerprint and force a puzzle after fingerprint change.
